policy: Every FREE use must appear here with explicit integer visible-ink bounds, a rationale, an approval_id, and a status. Release validation (require_free_approval=True, which the build script uses) demands status 'approved'. A draft run accepts 'proposed', so an agent can author a FREE icon and put the record up for review without being blocked -- but a proposed record never ships.

free_keyshapes.rationale: 1-D bar glyph. The short axis is entirely stroke-defined at 4 units; no standard keyshape has a 4-unit axis, and the smallest standard minor dimension is 16.
0-D point glyph rendered as a single round cap. Both axes are stroke-defined at 4 units; enlarging it to any standard keyshape would make it a circle, a different symbol.
Vertical transpose of minus. 1-D bar glyph whose short axis is stroke-defined at 4 units.
Typographic mark whose width is stroke-defined at 4 units. Widening it to a standard 16-unit minor axis would break its read as a single vertical stroke plus point.
Row of three stroke-defined points. Height is 4 units by construction; no standard keyshape has a 4-unit axis.
Vertical transpose of ellipsis. Width is stroke-defined at 4 units; no standard keyshape has a 4-unit axis.

statuses.proposed: Authored by an agent, awaiting human review. Draft only.
statuses.approved: Reviewed and accepted. Required for release.
